assertions.name: geometric_mean_is_exactly_one_over_two_q
assertions.note: b_pp b_nn = 1/[2]_q^2 identically; re-verified from qbeta_loop_value_pinned_probe.py, not new here

assertions.name: am_minus_gm_is_h_squared_over_twice_two_q
assertions.note: [2]_q^2 - 4 = (q - 1/q)^2 = h^2, so the AM-GM gap IS the Hecke parameter squared over 2[2]_q -- the deformation is literally the gap

assertions.name: bpn_is_a_convex_combination_of_the_like_species_bonds
assertions.note: w = 0.500343927702. This is the load-bearing input from the sibling's pn-bond-cannot-be-extremal (merged 2026-09-04); verified here numerically rather than assumed

assertions.name: and_it_is_the_half_plus_quarter_flavour_split_weight
assertions.note: residual -3.345e-7 -- agrees to 6 decimals, not exactly, because the sibling's delta is a particular flavour-split convention. Reported, not rounded away

assertions.name: the_corpus_weight_is_above_the_threshold_so_the_sign_is_wrong
assertions.note: w/threshold = 1.1167939; the p-n bond would have to be weighted ~11.7 % further toward the n-n end to get the SEMF sign

assertions.name: equal_weight_is_wrong_signed_for_every_q_above_one
assertions.note: delta(1/2) <= 0  <=>  1/2 >= 1/(q^2+1)  <=>  q >= 1. At q = 1 it is exactly zero (b_pp = b_nn, AM = GM). Every q > 1 breaks it, so no re-derivation of q rescues the sign

assertions.name: the_endpoints_are_qou_y2np_s_plus_minus_two_ln_q
assertions.note: qou-y2np's bar branch is the w=0 / w=1 pair of this convex family. Its 'one bit' is two points on a continuum whose crossing 1/(q^2+1) is derived -- which is the finer object
